claims.content: Capture the details of an MSIU Salesman to help the MSIU management team understand the performance of each Team or salesman.

goal.raw_text: Capture the details of an MSIU Salesman to help the MSIU management team understand the performance of each Team or salesman.

claims.content: VMU User
User is authenticated
Sales Team Master exists
System allows new entries for Salesman master
No duplicate ID exists for the salesman being registered
The VMU User initiates the registration of a new MSIU Salesperson by selecting to add a new entry in the MSIU Sales Team Information Master.

trigger.raw_text: The VMU User initiates the registration of a new MSIU Salesperson by selecting to add a new entry in the MSIU Sales Team Information Master.

claims.content: The VMU User enters the Salesman Code.
The VMU User enters the Name of the Salesman.
The VMU User enters the DOB & Age.
The VMU User selects or enters the Gender.
The VMU User enters the Communication Address.
The VMU User optionally enters the Contact No.
The VMU User optionally enters the E-Mail Id.
The VMU User selects the Sales-team from the separate master.
The system checks for duplicated ID for the salesman.
If a duplicate name is detected, the system gives a warning message to have the duplicate name or to change the name.
The system saves the new MSIU Salesperson record upon successful validation.
If a duplicate ID is detected for the salesman, the system rejects the registration and prompts the user to correct the ID.

If a duplicate name is captured, the system gives a warning message offering the option to proceed with the duplicate name or change it; if the user chooses not to resolve the warning, the registration may be halted.
A new MSIU Salesperson record is created and stored in the system with a unique ID.

The newly registered salesperson’s details (including Salesman Code, Name, DOB & Age, Gender, Communication Address, Contact No, E-Mail Id, and Sales-team) are captured and available for viewing by other users.
The registered salesperson becomes selectable from the Team Master during distribution transactions.
If a duplicate name was entered, the system has issued a warning message and either retained the name with a differentiating indicator or allowed the user to change it — as per design constraints.
